Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 3. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 4. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s

Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 5. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 6. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): 2 DAYS AGO . 7. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bidder must enclose following documents at the time of bid submission, bidder’s offer is liable to rejected i f they do not upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendu m if any. a) Manufacturer’s catalogues, b) Copy of Alternator Type test report issued in favour of Alternator manufacturer, c) Type Approval Certificate & COP of Engine set in favour of Engine manufacturer d) Copy of IP certificate AMF control Panel issued in favour of DG set manufacturer f) Type test report and Endurance test report for Engine as per IS: 10001latest / IS: 10002 latest g) Copy of Type Approval certificate and COP of DG Set, issued in favour of DG Set manufacturer h) Copy of ISO 9001:2015 certificate issued in favour of DG set manufacturer, i) Copy of ISO 14001:2015 certificate issued in favour of DG set manufacturer, j) Copy of ISO 45001:2018 certificate issued in favour of DG set manufacturer. Additional Technical Parameters for 40 KVA DG Set a) The Engine required 3 Cylinder, Liquid cooled, min. BHP 54 at 1500 rpm for 40 kVA DG Set b) Min Cubic capacity of offered Engine shall be 3298 CC is required. c) Lube Oil Sum Capacity Max 8.0 ltr .
